selectionProfile.methodology: Actual fresh-row adapter; 1,000 rows; 20 selection warmups, GC, then 100 alternating synchronous selections of the first two rows. Unminified CPU profile at 100 microseconds, no throttling. Diagnostic sample counts, not production timings.

methodology.cpu: Two passes in opposite framework order; ten samples, twenty for selection; default harness throttling and warmups.
methodology.memory: Three forced-GC mounted-page samples per framework.
methodology.limitations: One local machine; no concurrent tests or builds; system noise uncontrolled.

decision: Not adopted: about 3% less mounted-page memory, but partial updates were slower in both production passes (about 5% pooled). Runtime remains d3234db.
